_doc: The hangar (docs/CONTENT.md section 19) lists every ship design that has a `hangar` field {group, layout, unlock}: group is the tab (a race or a faction), layout is A, B or C, unlock is the id of an unlock (data/unlocks.json) or "" for a ship that is open from the start. The three first starters are regenerated by tests/tool_make_starters.gd, which does not write that field, so their entries live here: ship design id -> hangar. A design's own field wins over an entry here.
